div.head: Cn 1027 1
div.ab: Notifico vobis me noviter isse Romam, oratum pro redemptione peccaminum meorum et pro salute regnorum quique meo subiacent regimini populorum.
I make known to you that I have lately been to Rome to pray for the redemption of my sins and for the security of the realms and the peoples who are subject to my rule.
I make known to you that I have recently been to Rome, to pray for the remission of my sins and for the safety of the kingdoms and of the peoples which are subjected to my rule.
div.note: Latin only (Cnut's letter of 1027, c. May; Latin translation c. 1070–1100, the Old English original is lost). Liebermann's text is from Florence of Worcester (ed. MGH SS XIII 126), compared with Ox (Oxford, Corpus 157 p. 329) and William of Malmesbury II 183; text in column T. Liebermann gives no German translation.
